items.title: Large-bond-dimension MPS (GPU)
items.purpose: push the chi-convergence frontier of the cloud N=48 study (chi <= 256) to chi = 1024-4096, step by step, to locate where MPS fails for 4-10 first-order steps
items.needs: GPU nodes (cupy/torch backend of su2torus.mps), configs/n96_stripe_g1.25_gpu.json, scripts/slurm/mps_gpu.sbatch

items.title: PEPS with belief-propagation gauging
items.purpose: 2D tensor-network simulation of the same Trotter circuits; native to the honeycomb geometry, so no long-range MPS bonds across the torus
items.needs: new PEPS driver (quimb/ yastn style), GPU memory for bond dimension D = 4-16

items.title: Pauli propagation of local observables
items.purpose: Heisenberg-picture truncated Pauli-path simulation of <Z_p> and link energies; complementary failure mode to MPS (operator growth instead of entanglement)
items.needs: Pauli-propagation code with weight/coefficient truncation, many CPU cores

items.title: Sign-free QMC thermal anchor
items.purpose: the late-time thermal value at N = 48-64 (H is stoquastic: all off-diagonal elements <= 0, verified in M1), replacing exact diagonalization/typicality used up to N = 24
items.needs: stochastic series expansion or path-integral QMC code for this Hamiltonian; CPU hours

items.title: Quantum hardware runs
items.purpose: run the 4-10 step circuits (456-608 native-ZZ two-qubit gates per step) with echo and ZNE mitigation and compare with the classical frontier
items.needs: trapped-ion (native ZZ) or superconducting (CZ) device time; p2 <= 1e-3 for useful raw fidelity at 4 steps
